name: 44133 · N Royalton, OH
findings: ZIP 44133 (N Royalton) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44133 (N Royalton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44133 (N Royalton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
